description: Works with the Sales Navigator lead and account lists of a connected LinkedIn account. action list enumerates the existing lists (kind leads for people, accounts for companies) with id, name and item count. action browse returns the members of one list (listId); lead rows carry current_positions (company, role, company_id, company_url), and a company_id is accepted by a company profile lookup. action save ADDS a person or company to an existing list (listId plus providerId): for kind leads providerId is a lead id from a lead search or a person profile id (a messaging-thread participant identifier is a different identifier type that a profile lookup resolves to a person profile id); for kind accounts a company id from a company search or the company_id of a current_positions entry. In the hosted Assistant the person or company and the list are verified with LinkedIn before the request is sent, and the request is refused when either does not resolve. Paginates list and browse with offset plus limit, repeating the same kind and listId while the offset increases. New lists cannot be created via the API; they are created in Sales Navigator. Requires a connected LinkedIn account with an active Sales Navigator subscription.

action.description: Operation: list (enumerate the account's Sales Navigator lists), browse (read the members of one list), or save (add a lead or account to an existing list)

connectedAccountId.description: The id of a connected workspace LinkedIn account with a Sales Navigator subscription

kind.description: Which list family: leads (people, default) or accounts (companies)

limit.description: list and browse: items per page (1-100, default 10)

listId.description: Required for browse and save: the id of a Sales Navigator list, as returned by action list

providerId.description: Required for save. For kind leads: the id of a lead from a lead search, or a person profile id. For kind accounts: the id of a company from a company search, or the company_id of a current_positions entry on a lead search result, a list browse row or a person profile

workspace.description: Slug or id of the workspace to work in. Optional when the account has exactly one usable workspace; required when it has several. An API key always works in its own workspace.

name: linkedin_manage_sales_lists

outputSchema.description: list and browse return the page fields; save returns listId, providerId and status.

total.description: The provider's count of every matching row, present only when the provider reports one

title: Manage Sales Navigator lists
